radiology_report:
Tergooi MC
Department of Radiology
Date: 15 January 2025
Exam: Multiparametric MRI prostate

Clinical indication: PSA 10.0 ng/mL, rising trend. Prior biopsy confirmed Gleason 3+4 adenocarcinoma. Request for staging and lesion characterisation.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume is 28.64 mL. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal hypointense lesion within the peripheral zone at the base, predominantly left-sided, measuring approximately 12 mm in maximum diameter. On diffusion-weighted imaging, the lesion exhibits restricted diffusion with high signal intensity and corresponding low ADC values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences show early, rapid enhancement of the lesion relative to the surrounding gland. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. No suspicious lymphadenopathy or distant metastases are seen on the limited field of view.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion at the left base of the peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 28.64 mL; PSA density 0.349 ng/mL/mL.
Clinical T stage cT1c.
csPCa predicted probability 0.83261764.

previous_notes.author: Dr. M. Jansen (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient attended for routine review of PSA levels. PSA measured at 2.0 ng/mL, which was within normal limits. No immediate concerns raised at this visit, and routine annual monitoring was continued. The patient was advised to report any new lower urinary tract symptoms promptly.

pathology_report:
Specimen: Transperineal prostate biopsy, 10 September 2024

Histological examination of the submitted tissue cores reveals acinar adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. The tumour is located at the base and base left of the prostate. A cribriform growth pattern is present within the malignant glands.

Specimen: Transperineal prostate biopsy, 15 January 2025

Histological examination of the submitted tissue cores reveals acinar adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. The tumour is located at the base and base left of the prostate. A cribriform growth pattern is present within the malignant glands.

The histological trajectory across timepoints is stable, with no change in Gleason score or ISUP grade group, although the cribriform pattern persists in the most recent sample.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 4.
